matter_background.original: There are three parties to a Deed of Partition of a property in Galle to be executed before you.
matter_background.normalized: There are three parties to a Deed of Partition of a property in Galle to be executed before you.

questions.question_original: You are a Notary who has a License to practice in Colombo. One party to the Partition Deed is in Galle who is bedridden and unable to come to your office. But the other 2 parties are residing in Colombo and can come to your office to execute the Deed. Give 2 methods by which you could arrange to have the Deed of Partition executed by the party who is bed ridden and the precautions you should take to ensure the Deed will be signed by all three parties.
